episode_results.instruction: Using arms, pick up the bottle with green cap, the transparent bottle, and the drink bottle with slim neck, dropping each into the trash bin.
Put the smooth yellow bottle with ridged cap into the smooth black dustbin, followed by the medium-sized water bottle and the rounded bottle with a white neck.
Use arms to move the bottle made of smooth plastic, the water bottle with textured body, and the bottle with curved body shape into the black bin with white liner.
Put the bottle made of smooth plastic into the rectangular black trash holder, followed by the bottle with narrow neck and the black soda bottle with white top.
Move the bottle with green cap, the transparent bottle, and the red-labeled soda bottle into the dustbin with white inner bag one by one.
Use arms to pick the medium yellow cylindrical bottle, drop it in the smooth black dustbin, repeat for the medium-sized water bottle and the drink bottle with slim neck.
Carry the bottle with small ridged green cap first, drop it into the black bin with white liner, repeat with the medium-sized water bottle and the black bottle with red label.
Transfer the bottle with green cap, the medium-sized water bottle, and the drink bottle with slim neck into the black dustbin using your arms, one by one.
Use the arms to move the bottle made of smooth plastic into the black garbage bin, then repeat for the cylindrical bottle and the drink bottle with slim neck.
Using arms, grab the medium yellow cylindrical bottle and put it in the plastic dustbin, repeat for the water bottle with textured body and the smooth plastic bottle.
Place the yellow liquid container with green top, the bottle with turquoise cap, and the drink bottle with slim neck in the black garbage bin using the arms.
Use arms to pick the medium plastic bottle with tapered neck, drop it in the rectangular black trash holder, repeat for the bottle with narrow neck and the hand-sized drinking bottle.
Grab the bottle with small ridged green cap, put it in the dustbin with white inner bag, follow by moving the blue-accented cylindrical bottle and the smooth plastic bottle there too.
Move the cylindrical yellow bottle for holding liquids to the dustbin with lid and bag, then the blue-accented cylindrical bottle, and finally the bottle with curved body shape.
Use arms to pick the medium plastic bottle with tapered neck, the smooth transparent plastic bottle, and the red bottle, dropping them into the trash bin.
Use arms to pick the smooth yellow bottle with ridged cap, the bottle with narrow neck, the red-labeled soda bottle, and place them one by one in the black and white trash holder.
Carefully grab the yellow liquid container with green top, the medium-sized water bottle, and the red and black beverage bottle and position them in the black dustbin.
Take the smooth yellow bottle with ridged cap, drop it in the plastic dustbin, then move the transparent bottle and the red and black beverage bottle to the plastic dustbin.
Using arms, grab the medium yellow cylindrical bottle and put it in the medium black garbage container, repeat for the bottle for holding liquids and the red bottle.
Use arms to move the bottle made of smooth plastic, the clear bottle with blue sections, and the plastic bottle with red cap into the medium black garbage container.
